orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Alok Kumar Verma
orders.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND 
AT NAINITAL
THE HON’BLE SRI JUSTICE ALOK KUMAR VERMA
25TH MARCH, 2025
WRIT PETITION (S/S) NO. 634 of 2025
Mohan Chandra Pant ……..Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand and Others ..…Respondents
Counsel for the Petitioner : Mr. Suryakant Maithani, 
 Advocate.
Counsel for the Respondents : Mr. Bhupendra Singh 
 Koranga, Brief Holder. 
Hon’ble Alok Kumar Verma,J.
Present Writ Petition has been filed under Article 
226 of the Constitution of India with the following 
prayers:-
“(i) Issue a Writ, Order or direction in the nature 
of certiorari to call for the record and quash the 
impugned order dated 16-04-2025 passed by 
the respondents (contained as Annexure No.9 to 
this writ petition), whereby recovery of 
Rs.12,90,336/- has been sanctioned from retiral 
dues of the petitioner. 
(ii) Issue a Writ, Order or direction in the nature 
of mandamus commanding the respondents to 
release entire dues without any recovery. 
(iii) Pass any other writ, order or direction, 
which this Hon’ble Court may deem fit and 
proper in the facts and circumstances of the 
case.  2
(iv) Award the cost of the writ petition to the 
Petitioners.”
2. The petitioner retired from his Group C post on 
28.02.2025. 
3. Heard Mr. Suryakant Maithani, learned counsel 
for petitioner and Mr. Bhupendra Singh Koranga, learned 
Brief Holder for respondents. 
4. The effect and operation of the impugned 
recovery order dated 16.04.2025 (Annexure No.9 to the 
writ petition) are kept-in-abeyance till further order. 
5. Mr. Bhupendra Singh Koranga, learned Brief 
Holder for the State has sought time to get instruction on 
the remaining interim relief.
6. Time is granted. 
7. List on 23.05.2025 along with WPSS No.309 of 
2025. 
___________________
ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
Dated: 25.04.2025
Pant/
